_readme: A deliberately small, structured slice of a real Shopware B2B catalogue (the source shop),
collected 2026-09-11, corrected 2026-09-14, for questions the generated catalogues cannot ask.
AMBIGUITY, EASY AXIS: 72 tyres, 24 in each of three vehicle worlds. 'Reifen' matches all
three, and the NAMES carry hints ('Ganzjahresreifen', 'Marathon Plus'), so a model has
something to go on even before the category.
AMBIGUITY, HARD AXIS: fasteners. 19 motorcycle screws and 5 bicycle screws, and BOTH worlds
contain a product named exactly 'Innensechskantschraube' — the same name, different vehicle,
nothing in the name to tell them apart. The remaining 28 bicycle fasteners are washers and
nuts, which is why an earlier slice of this category produced a FALSE ambiguity: its first 24
products contained no screw at all, so answering 'Schrauben' with motorcycle parts only was
correct rather than a silent guess. Keep screws in both worlds or this axis measures nothing.
DOCUMENTS: 21 motorcycle batteries carry real attached PDFs, up to eleven per product, several
being the same datasheet in eight languages — a shape the document feature does not collapse.
PRICES AND STOCK ARE INVENTED. This shop shows prices only to logged-in dealers, so nothing
here was scraped; both derive from the product number and are meaningless. Names, category
paths are real; document URLs are placeholders.
IDS ARE PREFIXED 'pt-'. A bare product number is a numeric string, which PHP coerces to an int
as an array key — FactRenderer::retrievedIds() then returns ints and GroundingOutputProcessor
crashes on str_contains(). Real Shopware ids are 32-char hex.
